note: Treg subsetting on CCR4 × CD45RO, four-quadrant layout. CCR4pos_CD45ROpos: skin-homing memory Treg — upper-right quadrant (CCR4+, CD45RO+). CCR4pos_CD45ROneg: skin-homing naive-like Treg — lower-right quadrant (CCR4+, CD45RO-). CCR4neg_CD45ROpos: non-skin-homing memory Treg — upper-left quadrant (CCR4-, CD45RO+). CCR4neg_CD45ROneg: non-skin-homing naive-like Treg — lower-left quadrant (both -).
tips: Treg memory / homing quadrants (parallel annotation to Step 4 on the same Treg parent). CD45RO is the classical memory-T-cell marker (inverse of CD45RA); CD45RO+ marks antigen-experienced Treg. CCR4 again marks tissue-homing capacity. CCR4pos_CD45ROpos: CCR4+ CD45RO+. CCR4pos_CD45ROneg: CCR4+ CD45RO-. CCR4neg_CD45ROpos: CCR4- CD45RO+. CCR4neg_CD45ROneg: CCR4- CD45RO- (the original Miyara scheme is defined on CD45RA × Foxp3/CD25 rather than CD45RO; CD45RA is not in panel, so the resting/memory split relies on CD45RO alone).
